chapter.title: Useful Items and Tips
subtitle: Fourteen small things that make the valley easier to live in.
Not one of them is required, and every one is already installed.

hover: J opens it. Nothing in it locks.
Nine blocks a swing, one durability.
And then straight into the bag.
Nine days a sub-season. Twenty-seven a season.
Oda nailed this list up herself.

quests.title: Look It Up Before You Build It
quests.subtitle: The item list on the right knows every recipe.
description: Type a name into the box under the item list. Click an item for its recipe; right-click it for what it goes into.
&bR&r and &bU&r do the same from the keyboard.

quests.title: Type @ to See One Mod's Shelf
quests.subtitle: And # for a tag, $ for tooltip text.
description: Put &b@&r in front of a mod name to show only its items: @create, @thermal.
&b#&r finds tags and &b$&r finds tooltip text, for when you know what a thing does but not its name.

quests.title: Sort a Chest Without Dragging Anything
quests.subtitle: Three small buttons above every container.
description: Open a chest and look at its top right: three buttons sort the chest, and three more sort your own bag.
Bind a key under &bOptions - Controls&r instead if you like.

quests.title: Read the Block You Are Pointing At
quests.subtitle: The little bar at the top of the screen.
description: Point at anything and the bar names it, says which mod it came from, and shows what the machine inside is doing.
Point at an animal for its health; at a crop for how grown it is.

quests.title: Write Down the Three Numbers
quests.subtitle: Home is -319 74 32. The square is -302 69 -44.
description: Press &bF3&r — on a Mac laptop, &bfn&r + &bF3&r. The XYZ line top left is where you stand; the line under it is the way you face.
Josie's hearth reads &b-319 74 32&r. Oda's square reads &b-302 69 -44&r.

quests.title: Learn the Four Keys That Matter
quests.subtitle: J, B, C, Home. All of them move.
description: &bJ&r opens this book. &bB&r opens your backpack. &bC&r picks a chest up with everything still in it.
&bHome&r lists where you died — a Mac laptop has no Home key, so use &bfn&r + &bleft arrow&r, or bind it to something else.
All four move under Options - Controls.

rewards.title: Back to the valley
rewards.description: Next: the story picks up in Start Here. Everything on this board keeps working while you play.

quests.title: Craft a Hammer and Break Nine at Once
quests.subtitle: Three by three, one swing, one durability.
description: Craft a &aStone Hammer&r. Held instead of a pickaxe, it takes a 3x3 face of stone in one go.
Iron and diamond versions dig faster. Bram keeps his on the bench.

quests.title: Hold One Key and Take the Whole Seam
quests.subtitle: The key above Tab. No enchantment needed.
description: Hold the &bgrave key&r (above Tab) as you break an ore or a log. Up to 64 blocks of that vein come out at once.
Drops gather where you broke it. See the &6Ores and Mining&r chapter.

quests.title: Wear a Backpack and Feed It Two Upgrades
quests.subtitle: B opens it, on your back or in your bag.
description: Craft a &aBackpack&r. Wear it in the back slot or carry it; &bB&r opens it either way.
Add a &aMagnet Upgrade&r and a &aPickup Upgrade&r: drops come to you and land inside.

quests.title: Carry a Calendar and Sow in Season
quests.subtitle: Nine days a sub-season, twenty-seven a season.
description: Craft a &aCalendar&r. Held, it names the season, and a crop planted out of its season simply stops growing.
Which crop wants which season is in the &6Farm and Seasons&r chapter.

quests.title: Get Back Something You Lost
quests.subtitle: The letter, the deed, the kettle, the book.
description: Type &b/valley keepsake&r for the list, then &b/valley keepsake book&r for a fresh copy of anything on it.
Every one-of-a-kind story item is on it. Nothing you can lose stays lost.

quests.title: Read the Stone Under the Valley
quests.subtitle: One command, four minutes, ore where you dig.
description: If your world was made before the ore pass ran, type &b/valley ores&r once. It walks the valley chunk by chunk and puts iron, coal, copper, gold, redstone, lapis and diamond back into the stone.
It stutters for three or four minutes. Keep playing.

quests.title: Turn Down Anything You Are Sick Of
quests.subtitle: One sound, or all the pop-ups but the journal.
description: Bind the sound muffler under &bOptions - Controls&r. Its screen lists whatever just played; tick the one you are tired of.
Recipe and tutorial pop-ups are already off. The ones you still get are Josie's journal.

quests.title: Talk Out Loud If You Have a Microphone
quests.subtitle: Caps Lock to talk, K to mute, 48 blocks.
description: Hold &bCaps Lock&r to talk, &bK&r to mute. Voices carry 48 blocks, half that if you whisper.
&b=&r opens groups, so a party split across the valley still hears itself.
